summary: Confirmed on the park's 2026 rates page: water/electric $39 off-season / $44 peak / $49 holiday, full hookup $44 / $50 / $55, 3-night holiday-weekend minimum (now in booking.min_stay), May 1 - Oct 31 season; Campspot live for 2026-10-29 ($42 W/E and $47 FHU with the $3 booking fee folded in, matching the stored $39-50 + $3/stay). Added max_rig_ft 46 (Campspot), pull-through, dump, Campspot url. Fees left as recorded (2026-10-13 read still matches). Base $39-44 for a 23-ft motorhome: under the US$50 gate (holiday $49 also under). Not waterfront confirmed: the Deerfield River is ~500 m south across Route 2.
flags: Homepage carries a stale banner ('The campground is closed until May 1 2025, the reservation line will reopen after Jan. 20, 2025') beside 'Online reservations for 2026 season will begin January 15th, 2026' - an out-of-date notice, not a closure; the rates page and Campspot are current for 2026.

Seasonal share (informational, passes long-stay test 4): spring imagery shows ~50+ trailers parked in the north loops, and all 2026 seasonal sites are taken with a 2027 waiting list; but Campspot sells ~68 hookup RV sites nightly, so it is an ordinary transient park.
